# Dark Media Tech

> Dark Media Tech is a Mangalore studio for web development, branding, video production, SEO, and social media. The studio is based in Mangaluru, Karnataka, and also works with clients in the GCC.

## Core Capabilities

- [Web Development](https://darkmedia.tech/services/web-development): Websites and web applications.
- [Web Design and Development in Mangalore](https://darkmedia.tech/services/web-development/mangalore): Website development company in Mangalore.
- [Web Design and Development in Karnataka](https://darkmedia.tech/services/web-development/karnataka): Website development company in Karnataka.
- [Web Design and Development in Bangalore](https://darkmedia.tech/services/web-development/bangalore): Website development company in Bangalore.
- [Branding](https://darkmedia.tech/services/branding): Visual identity, logos, and brand systems.
- [Video Production](https://darkmedia.tech/services/video-production): Corporate films, commercials, and brand video.
- [SEO and Analytics](https://darkmedia.tech/services/seo-analytics): Technical SEO, local search, and analytics.
- [Social Media Management](https://darkmedia.tech/services/social-media-management): Social content and campaign management.
